parameters.name: ApiDestinationNamePrefix
parameters.description: The prefix of the API destination name.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to be returned in a call. You can use this parameter and NextToken to implement paging.

*   Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
If you set Limit and excess return values exist, this parameter is returned.

*   Default value: 0.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eventbridge list-api-destinations --api-destination-name-prefix api-demo --connection-name connection-name --max-results 10 --next-token 0 --region cn-hangzhou
